disposition_reason: The registered real-data scope is a curation/quality/yield comparison without ground-truth spike assignments or a defensible single performance ordering. The paper has separate simulation accuracy experiments, but substituting them would change this task and requires a separately reviewed registration.

source_paper.title: Opening the black box toward a modular approach to spike sorting

evidence.locator: Figure 8 caption (publisher-indexed text retrieved; direct article access challenged)
evidence.supports: Real-data comparison uses three recordings and explicitly describes curation counts as proxy measurements.
Simulation sorter benchmarks and real-data curation are distinct source analyses.

evidence.locator: Dataset docstring and np1/np2/cn protocol lists
evidence.supports: Names the IBL UCLA034, UCL AL032_2020-01-07 and Duszkiewicz A3702 inputs and motion-correction conditions.
Source sorter parameters and analyzer preprocessing; Kilosort common-reference/bandpass order differs from other protocols.
Complete unit counts, Bombcell good/MUA/noise, UnitRefine SUA/MUA/noise and number of SLAy merge groups are the reported outputs, not ground-truth spike matches.

target.description: Reconstruct and compare the Figure 8 real-recording curation outputs of Kilosort4, Lupin, TriDesClous 2 and SpyKING-CIRCUS 2. These diagnostics do not define an ordered spike-accuracy objective.

dataset.description: Source names DANDI 000409 UCLA034, UCL AL032_2020-01-07 and DANDI 000939 A3702. Exact immutable bytes remain unresolved; the existing A3702 inventory filename does not establish equivalence to the source ses-191126 filename.

cohort.description: Figure 8 includes three real recordings spanning chronic Neuropixels 2.0, acute Neuropixels 1.0 and chronic 64-channel Cambridge Neurotech recordings. A single-recording curation component cannot represent the whole source comparison.

split.description: The source Figure 8 analysis is a whole-recording sorter/curation comparison with no supervised train/test accuracy split; introducing a new labeled holdout changes this task.

inputs.description: Raw extracellular recordings, probe geometry, the four source sorter protocols, and source curation tools/models. UnitRefine consumes pretrained classifiers; their exact weights remain an execution hold.

preprocessing.description: Source uses motion correction for IBL and no-motion protocols for UCL/Duszkiewicz. Analyzer pipelines reverse common-reference and bandpass order between Kilosort and other sorters; effective dependency defaults and common-condition comparability remain unqualified.

metric.description: Per-sorter counts: total units; Bombcell good plus non_soma_good, MUA plus non_soma_MUA, noise; UnitRefine SUA/MUA/noise; count of proposed SLAy merge groups. Increasing good-unit yield alone need not improve true spike assignments.

aggregation.description: Each recording/sorter produces its own curation row; the source does not define a single ranking combining quality proxies, drift visualization and sorter agreement.

comparison.primary_metric: No defensible ordered accuracy endpoint for the registered real-recording proxy comparison

published_baseline.description: Figure 8 reports descriptive proxy counts rather than a scalar accuracy baseline to surpass. The source simulation accuracy study is a different registered scope.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No audited native sorter/curator reference is established; reproducing curation counts would calibrate the analysis only.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful increase in accuracy cannot be defined from a yield or curation-label count alone.

uncertainty.method: No paper-win inference for this ineligible endpoint.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Recordings for descriptive comparisons; units and spikes within a recording are dependent.
uncertainty.rationale: Uncertainty on proxy counts does not supply missing ground truth or a valid success ordering.

paper_win_requires: This registration cannot award a same-task paper win from larger yields, improved curation labels, a visually stable raster, or a lower p-value.

Any proposed replacement must be separately reviewed and tied to the original source simulation benchmark, exact generator/ground-truth conditions and source accuracy metric; do not relabel the existing A3702 analysis as that task.
Retain all source recordings and sorter conditions when reproducing Figure 8; restricting to the bounded local component is calibration only.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison is established by curation counts or by this source review.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive for paper-win scoring because the registered Figure 8 diagnostics do not define an ordered accuracy target. Historical table reconstruction can still be calibrated.
episode.candidate_freeze: Any future eligible replacement must freeze its own exact source task and comparator before candidate development.
episode.final_evaluation: No final paper-win evaluation is admitted for this registration.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep author real-data proxy outputs distinct from ground-truth simulation accuracy. A local count table or generated engineering control is not an author performance baseline.

blocking_issues: Registered real-data proxies do not establish ground-truth sorting accuracy.
Native reference results, source-recording byte identity, sorter/default versions and curation-model hashes are not verified.
The existing evaluator covers only A3702 post-native curation/raster analysis; the source real-data figure uses three recordings.

legacy.notes: Existing curation table reconstruction, Bombcell-good raster export and generated controls remain calibration components. Their successful execution is not surpassing the paper.
